SOURCE EVIDENCE: SimulatorNode registers the absolute /simulator/spawn service (src/simulator.cpp:42-45) and /simulator/add_anchor (src/simulator.cpp:47-50); the header declares only spawn_srv and anchor_srv (include/map_simulator/simulator.h:33-39). No stop, pause or removal service exists. The only robot command is a geometry_msgs/Twist subscription on <robot_namespace>cmd_vel (src/robot.cpp:219-226); its callback copies linear.x, linear.y and angular.z into odom.twist.twist. The odom publisher is on <robot_namespace>odom (src/robot.cpp:214). The default scan topic and 100 samples are set at src/robot.cpp:131-132, and the fallback scan publisher (angle_max=49*M_PI/50, range 0.1..5) is created at src/robot.cpp:194-211. Spawn.srv has request fields and an empty response (srv/Spawn.srv:1-19). A duplicate spawn only calls resetTo (src/simulator.cpp:53-65), which assigns the pose and clears odom.pose.pose and odom.twist.twist (include/map_simulator/robot.h:135-143); it is not an acknowledged stop and does not fence another ROS publisher. A zero Twist publication is transmission-only (rosbridge returns published=true, confirmed=false). The real odom/scan publishers exist only after a robot_description message (src/robot.cpp:113-126,170-214). The stock RosBridge therefore reports safe_state.achieved=false for this effectful profile, and the stock e-stop fails with MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED; that is the concrete blocker, not a fake defect.

WHAT IS IMPLEMENTED: a configuration-only ROS 2 RosDriver over rosbridge, no Python native class. Extension capabilities: x-cap.okermorgant.spawn.v1 (invoke; the /simulator/spawn service with namespace, x, y, theta, radius, shape 0/1/2 and a 3-element rectangle size; the empty response is reported only as acknowledged), x-cap.okermorgant.twist.v1 (invoke; publish geometry_msgs/Twist linear.x, linear.y and angular.z on /robot1/cmd_vel; output published/confirmed, confirmed is always false), x-cap.okermorgant.odometry.v1 (read; one nav_msgs/Odometry pose.pose and twist.twist on /robot1/odom) and x-cap.okermorgant.scan.v1 (read; one sensor_msgs/LaserScan geometry and ranges on /robot1/scan). The resource state is odom_pose and odom_twist read from /robot1/odom; the scan is an explicit observation, not an automatic snapshot. The declaration is for one configured namespace, /robot1; the deployed robot must be spawned there and must receive its robot_description.
